run_apidoc: run the sphinx apidoc generator to auto-generate RST module docs from the pytext source tree
setup: setup the sphinx app by registering the patched python domain and connecting the apidoc builder callback
PatchedPythonDomain_resolve_xref: resolve cross-references in sphinx python domain docs while stripping the refspecific node attribute
review_conf_py: review the sphinx conf.py configuration file to understand extensions, theme, and mock module settings
summarize_conf_py: summarize the sphinx documentation configuration including project metadata, extensions, and output options
